_comment: Hard ceiling on billable spend per calendar month, enforced in code before any
paid call, not reported after the fact.
200 dollars is set to match your own line: above that, PropStream Pro at 199
with skip tracing included is the better deal, so the system refuses to drift
past the point where it stops making sense.
hardStop true means a run that would exceed the cap is refused outright.
Set it false to have runs trimmed to whatever the remaining budget affords
Every cost in the system flows through the ingest_runs table, so 'gf spend'
sees all of it. On the free sources this stays at zero forever.
